headline: Claude Stumbles Across Its Entire Stack
lede: Anthropic’s consumer app, coding assistant, and API all reported elevated errors. The outage turned a routine status notice into a referendum on how much work now depends on one provider.

headline: Nvidia Loses Its Founder at Full Speed
lede: Jensen Huang’s resignation leaves Nvidia facing investigations, investor unease, and an abrupt succession problem. The allegations remain contested, but the company must now separate executive conduct from the machinery of an AI-chip empire.
pullquote: A founder’s shadow can be an asset until it becomes the succession plan.

headline: IceWM Keeps the Lightweight Desktop Alive
lede: IceWM gives X11 users a fast, configurable window manager without the weight of a full desktop environment. Taskbars, workspaces, themes, and keyboard control remain the interface; the debate is whether Wayland can preserve that simplicity.

headline: Rust Finally Stabilizes the Never Type
lede: Rust 1.100 lands the long-awaited never type alongside allocator APIs, DropGuard, and Cargo changes aimed at safer dependency handling. It is a release about closing language gaps while making build systems a little more deliberate.

headline: Brave Lets Agents Pay Per Search
lede: Brave Search now answers HTTP 402 with a price and payment instructions, allowing an agent to settle each request in USDC. The design removes subscriptions and API keys from the path, while adding wallets, Base, and spending limits to the machinery beneath it.

headline: Europe’s Electric-Car Sales Jump 49 Percent
lede: Battery-electric sales in Europe rose 49 percent in October as global EV purchases continued to expand unevenly. Policy, incentives, tariffs, and year-ago comparisons do as much work as consumer demand in these numbers.

headline: A $300 Embroidery Machine Gets Its Freedom
lede: When useful software arrived behind a subscription, one builder wrote ZigZag instead. The open-source app turns images into stitch patterns, speaks several machine formats, and connects local hardware to a modern desktop and command-line workflow.

headline: When the Helpful Tool Simply Vanishes
lede: Claude’s status history reads like a ledger of modern dependence: outages in the app, API, connectors, and companion tools. A missed deadline exposes the quiet bargain behind convenience—that a borrowed capability is never entirely yours.

headline: Google Pairs Fast Models With Hard Problems
lede: Gemini 4 Hydrogen handles routine coding while Orchestrator calls in the more capable Carbon when planning or recovery demands it. Google reports lower quota use and faster completion, turning model selection into a product feature rather than a developer chore.

headline: A Distant World Takes 281 Years
lede: Astronomers have identified 2026 ED138 far beyond Pluto, with archival observations confirming an object that needs roughly 281 years to circle the Sun. Its size and shape remain uncertain, but the discovery marks another gap filled in the outer solar system’s dark map.
